title: Huhuan Shaonü
synopsis: Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, practically invisible. Until she met Li Zhao… Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream. “Clothing can not only change a person's temperament, but also give them boundless confidence,” this saying inspired Ye Xi to embark on her own fashion design journey. She wondered, what kind of transformation could this path bring her? Fortunately, she wasn't alone on this journey. She gained two good friends: the sweet-looking, dramatic Bai Xiaotao and the academically gifted Sun Zhiya. This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments!
